meta.name: process:documents
meta.description: 231 (plan stage C, C3b3; DECISIONS 231): the processing of a folder's or some chosen files' documents as a process pack (until C3 a plain kind of work package and a workflow step kind): a case makes its processing package from its source, a person starts its live run within the package's estimate, and the case is done once a live run is approved; the package's processing, review and result open from the case's page.

changelog.note: 231 (C3b3): the first version: the document processing step (process_documents@1, the documents' maker) and its tabs: Documents, History.
